title: Mark W Possible NDE 8625
content: In 2012, I was celebrating on getting a new job. I was out with friends and I had consumed way too much alcohol. I had an altercation with door staff of a nightclub. The security staff had to restrain me and used body pressure on my chest. I remember a lot of shouting going on but then something amazing happened. I saw a bright light and felt so much love flowing through me. I felt at peace and my thoughts of my love for my children flowed through my body. I was no longer intoxicated. I just felt at peace while I was somewhere I can't explain. After a while, I came back around and awoke sitting up. I believe God gave me a chance to sort my life out and let me return to my life. But I have to say, I'm not afraid to meet the lord because the experience I had was heavenly. I hope my experience will give even one person a chance to turn to our lord and pray to him. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 21/07/2012 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Intoxicated on alcohol. Security personal from nightclub used body pressure on my chest to restrain me when I was intoxicated. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? I felt amazing and love flowed through my body. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was very intoxicated on alcohol but in flash I was not intoxicated anymore and somewhere beautiful. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. It was like time had stopped and time meant nothing. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could not see but it was Bright and love flowed through my body. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could not hear anything. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Very bright light but amazing. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Heavenly What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt Lots of love and I was at Peace. It felt heavenly. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control. My love for my children Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. The feelings and Peace I had felt was like nothing on this earth. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt love and the experience was amazing. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I'm a good person now and try to show love. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It was a Heavenly experience I can't explain. I was at peace. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I know love and god are the same. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Heavenly What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. The experience opened my eyes to be good and to love. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? All questions are O.K.

arrival.other_being_detail: He reported encountering “a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin,” but also stated he “did not see any beings.”

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as “somewhere beautiful,” “a clearly mystical or unearthly realm,” and “heavenly,” with a very bright light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Intoxication with alcohol and being restrained by nightclub security using body pressure on his chest.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported a sudden clearing of intoxication and being “somewhere beautiful,” with bright light, love/peace, unity/oneness, and then awakening sitting up.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel; experience centered on bright light/love/peace in a heavenly realm, a brief past flash, then return/awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported that while extremely intoxicated, “in flash I was not intoxicated anymore” during the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw a bright light and felt so much love flowing through me.” / “It was like time had stopped and time meant nothing.” / “I was no longer intoxicated.” / “I'm not afraid to meet the lord because the experience I had was heavenly.”
